physical_confirmation_interpretation: The original live-host-summary.json PENDING_USER_CONFIRMATION value is historical and remains byte-identical. The later physical-keyboard-user-confirmation.json contains the user reply 两项均正常 for only the two stated checks.
limitations: Notepad was a real installed native ARM64 application using the independently observed current product DLL. The automated driver still used synthetic OS keyboard/mouse input.
The two later human keyboard confirmations are limited to 2jru with Shift+1 and 2 with Escape; they do not cover an entire physical matrix.
Notepad was tested only in its current active mode; no three-mode live-app acceptance is claimed.
The first registered x86-shorthand failure remains preserved and unexplained despite two later passes.
Candidate code annotations visibly ellipsize. A border/client-width explanation remains a hypothesis because window geometry was not measured.
The Explorer PID used for focus-loss observation was independently identified and predates the test; only a new window is claimed.
Capture captured_at metadata records archival timing after screenshots, not exact key-event timestamps.
The final four-character text is the end of the automated run and is not asserted to be the current document after the user confirmation.
Further x64/x86 app evidence and final acceptance decisions are pending; do not treat this draft as a no-issues seal.
